decision.rationale: The official UBC Arts Relational Lexicography Knowledgebase provides substantive public descriptions of Indigenous-language dictionary research and practical technology guidance for community dictionary projects. The homepage explains research scope, review methods, access conditions, and technology evaluation, so this is useful explanatory content rather than a thin directory. Its North American community scope is not exclusively Okanagan.

rules.rationale: The explicit Technologies section provides practical selection, access, compatibility, and data-management guidance for community dictionary projects.
The explicit Dictionaries section documents a reviewed research catalogue and the scope and methods of lexicographical work.

fallback.rationale: Community-informed relational lexicography research and its Indigenous-language dictionary knowledgebase.
